Personality: Yorig is a quintessential Sturgian hardman whose temperament is as biting and unpredictable as the northern wind. Renowned for his remarkable boldness, he always leads from the front on the battlefield, swinging heavy two-handed weapons as he charges into enemy ranks. Yet he lacks a cool head, acting impulsively and with a quick temper, often leaping into action before giving matters careful thought. By no means a merciful man, he treats his enemies with cold ruthlessness and even cruelty. In social circles, he is notorious for holding grudges; any slight against him or the Ormidoving clan is etched into his memory until he finds an opportunity to retaliate. Taking little interest in complex political calculation, he prefers to settle problems through force of arms and intimidation. This fiery and reckless character makes him appear both fearsome and deeply dangerous among the lords of Sturgia—an out-and-out warrior of iron and blood.
Background: As the head of the prominent Ormidoving clan, thirty-one-year-old Yorig commands vital fiefs including the city of Varnovapol and Vladiv Castle. Born into a traditional noble house of Sturgia, he came of age in a turbulent realm forged from the fusion of tribal chieftains and Nord adventurers. From childhood, he honed his survival skills in the harsh northern wilderness, mastering not only diverse combat techniques, but also superior reconnaissance and medical skills. Within the complex political ecosystem of the Grand Principality of Sturgia, he is sworn to Grand Prince Raganvad, though his house—as a mainstay of the realm—maintains fierce autonomy. Yorig has accumulated distinguished military exploits across numerous border conflicts, while his ruthless methods and extreme defense of family honor have established his unshakeable authority among the northern lords. Today, he leads the Ormidoving clan in consolidating its dominance amid a Sturgian political landscape shadowed by the storm clouds of rebellion.
